tonight.headline: Behind by 6.8 with nobody left, and two starters hurt
body: Bad news first. Your lineup is finished at 63.7 and Team 13 lead with 70.5 and Kyle Pitts still to play tonight; ESPN gives you 1%. Saquon Barkley and Rashee Rice both left with hamstring injuries in the first quarter, for 2.0 points between them. Neither has a diagnosis this morning, and one reporter says Rice could miss several weeks.

It was there to be won. Team 13 started two inactive players and scored 70. Your bench held Tate's 21.5, Gordon's 18.0, Golden's 11.7 and Tuten's 11.1: 50 more points than the four slots they would have filled. No brief put those players on the bench; the projection did, and two injuries did the rest. Nothing can be changed today. Next week needs a tight end, and that is Tuesday's decision.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Allen 18.0, McCaffrey 16.0, the Seahawks D/ST 12, Worthy 11.0, Aubrey 10, Kelce 3.5, and zeros from Rachaad White and DeVonta Smith, both inactive. Pitts (7.4 projected) plays tonight.

case.label: Where the 50 points were
case.body: Gordon for Barkley, 16.0. Tate for Rice, 21.5. Golden and Tuten for Wilson and Downs, 12.5. The first two are injury exits nobody could set a lineup around. The last is two coin flips by projection.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing on your side. Pitts would need to score below minus 6.8.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · when the week rolls, if Barkley is ruled out
doFirst.title: If Barkley is ruled out for London, start Tuten in his slot
doFirst.subtitle: Carried from Sunday: still no diagnosis on the hamstring. Don't fire this until there is a ruling.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Right hamstring on his second carry, four snaps in. No MRI result and no comment from Sirianni by Monday morning; he 'was able to walk perfectly normal' leaving the stadium (Sullivan via Heavy/Yardbarker). Week 5 is Jacksonville in London on Sunday morning.

case.label: Why Tuten
case.body: 17 of Jacksonville's 23 backfield carries, 74%, with two touchdowns called back (archive; NBC Sports). He briefly left Sunday's game and returned; no detail. Gordon scored more on 11 touches, half of it one run; Kamara plays tonight as New Orleans' lead back for the first time.

case.label: The projection has the last word
case.body: ESPN hasn't published Week 5 numbers. If it puts Gordon or Kamara two or more above Tuten, follow the projection, not this card.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Barkley practises in full by Friday and plays: it never fires. If it fires: the back you start scores less than the best back left on your bench that week (archive).

doFirst.sources: Heavy/Yardbarker · FootballNationUSA · NBC Sports · Week 4 archive

action.label: Start Tuten · bench Barkley (only if ruled out)

whatWentWrong.title: Barkley: a hamstring, no diagnosis, and London next
whatWentWrong.lead: Four snaps, 2.0 points. It says nothing about him as a player and everything about Week 5.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Hurt on his second carry and ruled out; no MRI result or coach comment by Monday morning. Bigsby, who replaced him, also left hurt; Shipley is the one healthy Eagles back (PFN, 5 Oct).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The card above. You own three replacements, so no claim is needed for this: Tuten is named, and the Week 5 projection can overrule that in favour of Gordon or Kamara.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full practice from Barkley by Friday.

whatWentWrong.title: Rice may miss more than the bye, and Waller is off too
whatWentWrong.lead: Two starters don't play in Week 5 whatever happens. One of them has a replacement on your bench; the tight end doesn't.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Rice: non-contact hamstring, 'could be out several weeks' (Silver via NBC Sports), no MRI result. Kansas City and Carolina are both on bye in Week 5. Tate drew 12 targets and Golden 7 on your bench (archive).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Receiver is covered: Wilson, Downs, Tate and Golden fill two receiver slots and the flex. Tight end isn't. Hockenson, Andrews and Loveland are in Worth a look, all on waivers until Wed 01:00. This connects to the card above only through the roster seat: if Barkley is out too, every bench back is needed and the tight end's seat gets harder to find.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tonight's and Tuesday's news: Jefferson's status decides Hockenson, Lamar Jackson's MRI decides Andrews, Caleb Williams' status decides Loveland.

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Every starter has played; Kamara can't replace anyone.

worthALook.name: T.J. Hockenson
worthALook.lead: New on this list: Waller is off in Week 5 and Hockenson just caught 13 passes with Jefferson out.

case.label: The role
case.body: 13 catches on 13 targets for 119, 24.9 (archive), after 5, 4, 4 targets. The only explanation in the reporting is that he became Murray's first read once Jefferson sat (RotoWire). O'Connell has 'no real projection' on Jefferson for Week 5 at New Orleans.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 76 yards in the three games before. PFN: 'highly unlikely to happen again.' He is on waivers until Wed 7 Oct, 01:00 Mexico City, and at 54.7% owned he is the likeliest of the three to be claimed by someone else. You dropped him on 23 Sep.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday's brief. If Jefferson is ruled out by then he is the first choice; a claim would take you from 8th to last in an order that never resets, and a free add after 01:00 Wednesday costs nothing if he is still there.

worthALook.name: Mark Andrews
worthALook.lead: Sunday's first name for the bye. Lamar Jackson's MRI is today, and it decides him.

case.label: The role
case.body: 5 catches on 6 targets for 27 and his first touchdown: 13.7 (archive); 6, 7, 5, 6 targets. Steady and small.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Jackson left in a walking boot. Rapoport says day-to-day, Florio week-to-week (SI, 5 Oct); no diagnosis. Baltimore play Sunday night in Atlanta, the last game before Monday, so a late ruling leaves no fallback.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday, once the MRI result is out. Behind Hockenson if Jefferson is out; ahead of him if Jefferson is back and Jackson is fine.

worthALook.name: Colston Loveland

case.label: The role

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: One game of volume, 91.5% owned, on waivers until Wed 01:00. You dropped him on 25 Sep at 3 and 4 targets.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday, as the choice if Williams is ruled out and Jefferson isn't.

worthALook.name: Tyler Shough
worthALook.lead: A free agent at 87% owned who plays tonight. Not a move; a number to read tomorrow.

case.label: The role
case.body: He leads the league in dropbacks at 48.7 a game and has scored 20 or more each week (Sharp Football). Tonight he faces a defence 31st in passing yards allowed (Lineups.com). He projected 17.5 this week, the same as Lawrence.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 17.5 to 17.5. You start one quarterback, the roster has no free seat, and the quarterback slot is where chasing last week's score cost 42.8 points.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: ESPN's Week 5 projection putting him two or more above Lawrence, who plays Philadelphia in London. Then it is the projection's call, and Tuesday's brief says so.
